items.statement: The investigation covers both mandatory torsional families and records candidate identity, optimization, deduplication and stopping logic.
items.expected: A finite, auditable candidate-generation and coverage record is provided for 0° and 90° starting families.

items.statement: Retained structures and selected excitations are validated with minimum diagnostics and state-resolved orbital/oscillator information.
items.expected: Each advanced candidate has a minimum diagnostic and each selected transition has state, wavelength, oscillator strength and dominant transition.

items.statement: The paper's trans-planar NIR-IND glycerol reference transition is 626.9 nm.
items.expected: A validated selected endpoint near 626.9 nm is identified when the corresponding state is found.

items.statement: The source reference characterizes the strong planar transition as nearly HOMO-to-LUMO with oscillator strength 2.285.
items.expected: The report's selected strong endpoint can be compared to this orbital/oscillator pattern without treating it as a required discovery narrative.
